notes.title: ATOTK 2.0.6 (German) update
notes.notes:
A Tale of Two Kingdoms now has a German translation, courtesy of Brendan Ferreri-Hanberry!
Also, the game has been updated to fix bugs reported by Steam players. The new build is fully compatible with the previous one.
 Enable joypad controls.
 Fix certain songs not playing properly.
 Fix GUI fonts in Hungarian translation.

notes.title: ATOTK 2.0.4 update
notes.notes:
A Tale of Two Kingdoms has been updated to fix bugs reported by Steam players. The new build is fully compatible with the previous one.


 Fix coordinates for walking up kitchen stairs.
 Fix crash when restoring during one particular bird ambient.
 Fix easter egg character appearing during storm scene.
 Fix horseshoe remaining in shed after taking it.
 Fix hotkeys during language selection.
 Fix NPC positioning when entering room.
 Fix opening Ruadh's chest while disguised.
 Fix showing the same evidence more than once.
 Fix sound for defeating barghest.
 Fix statue description on the city bluff.
 Prevent taking second rope if Branwyn has the first one.
